items.title: Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches - Official Trailer (2022) Alexandra Daddario | NYCC 2022
items.description:
Here's your look at the trailer for Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches, an upcoming series based on Rice's best-selling trilogy, Lives of the Mayfair Witches. The 8-episode series stars Alexandra Daddario, Jack Huston, Tongayi Chirisa, and Harry Hamlin.
